headline: Georgetown beats Syracuse to carry the conference alone
dek: Georgetown reached sixteen wins and 59 goals against Syracuse on the same day Akron fell at home to Wake Forest. Having lost only two matches all season while conceding eighteen goals, the program is the last in the conference still on the schedule.
displaced_by: Akron lost to Wake Forest on Nov 22, ending its one-loss record, while Georgetown beat Syracuse to reach sixteen wins
